messages:
Omar (Support): FYI — CardinalHealth just hit a hard stop in onboarding. SSO tokens failing, ingest stalled, and they told acct exec they may pause renewal in 30 days. Escalating to CS for priority handling. :warning:
Maya (CS): Ack. Can you paste the last error + customer-reported impact? We should triage risk and schedule enablement asap.
Omar (Support): Error from auth service: ```ERROR 401: invalid_assertion - missing audo_claim``` They also reported embeddings failing to appear in UI after ingest. Customer currently blocked on test environment verification.
Liam (Solutions): Sounds like token exchange failing between our IdP connector and their Okta config. Quick ask: can we give them a temporary API key fallback so they can finish verification before SSO is fixed?
Priya (AM): Customer is on CONTRACT-CH-2024, renewal in 29 days. They've used a pilot but this is their key success milestone. If we lose them, it's high risk. Please propose a comms plan and timeline.
Maya (CS): Proposed plan: 1) Immediate: grant temporary scoped API key (30d expiry) + quota bump to unblock tests; 2) Within 48h: joint call (CS + SE + Support + customer) to validate SSO config and ingest flow; 3) Follow-up: provide step-by-step checklist and confirmation window; 4) Exec touch if we can't resolve in 72h. Anyone object?
Omar (Support): I can create the temporary key now. DeployBot: created ticket INC-7890 and applied temporary key policy (key id tkey_03a) with 30d TTL.
DeployBot: Automated note: ticket INC-7890 assigned to Maya (CS), priority: P1.
Liam (Solutions): I'll join the 48h call and bring an SSO test harness. Can we set the call for tomorrow 11:00 PST?
Maya (CS): Tomorrow 11:00 PST works for me. Priya — can you own the renewal comms (email + internal playbook) and copy execs?
Priya (AM): On it. I'll draft an email to the customer with the temporary key instructions and propose the meeting link. Will also prepare an internal escalation note for RevOps.
Maya (CS): Action items: Omar — confirm temp key applied and send key name + redacted example to customer; Liam — SSO test harness and checklist; Priya — customer comms + exec note; Maya — run enablement call and follow bridging plan. Expect updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
